Greenways of mercy; supply lines that heal.

Level 3: Relief Run (BBTTCC)

Start travel to a low‑loyalty GenPop Hex: spend 1 Soft Power OP to reduce unrest by one step on arrival and gain advantage on the first Parley check.

Level 3: Field Medic

Proficiency in Medicine; bonus‑action stabilize + temp HP = PB (1/creature/long).

Level 6: Safe Convoy

Adjacent allies resist opportunity attack damage while you move.

Level 10: Decoy Column

1/short rest: enemy group Investigation vs your DC or pursue a false route for 1 min.

Level 14: Green Net

1/long rest: 30‑ft path grants allies +10 ft and advantage vs fear for 1 minute.
